cohort: 151 patients admitted with eclampsia to an intensive care unit of a tertiary medical facility between 1997 and 2017
finding: In this study, 16% of eclampsia patients developed PRES, with increased risk associated with eclampsia on presentation, recurrent seizures, postpartum eclampsia, cesarean delivery, and labetalol use.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of PRES development in eclampsia patients.
